answer: Incident: 240 keys, 3 fingerprints, one bond each. The fingerprint lane flagged the repeat models at intake, the per-epoch cap held every key at 40 POA, and idle keys lost 4% of standing while the operator waited for a payout that never scaled. Total captured 9,600 POA against 240,000 bonded. One quill wrote 240 answers, one copper line carried them, and the anchor was a single machine.
